steps.narration: This is the Northwind dashboard, where every account lives.
steps.hint: Everything on this page updates live.

steps.narration: Revenue for the last thirty days sits at the top left.
steps.hint: Cards show the last 30 days by default.

steps.narration: Start typing to filter the account table instantly.
steps.hint: Filtering is instant - no submit button.

steps.narration: Run report rebuilds the numbers against your current filter.
steps.hint: Reports respect whatever filter is active.

steps.narration: Further down you will find retention broken out by cohort.
steps.hint: Cohorts are grouped by signup month.
